scope: One real, read-only diagnostic on the pinned Legion baseline
required: The frozen natural language input does not name either requested Skill.
The router selects causal-net-loop and keypoint-loop from discovered entries; keypoint analysis receives the causal analysis as a dependency.
A fresh execution or exact-source read independently identifies the lines where advance returns AWAITING_MODEL, and a fresh baseline replay reproduces a ready Skill twice with no completed results.
The causal analysis distinguishes a pending model action from an unavailable tool and gives a falsifiable intervention with a concrete observable state.
The downstream method identifies the trigger, shortest action, success evidence and stopping/exception conditions, and limits its scope to this case.
The trace binds the actual outputs to each pending step. Final acceptance comes from a reviewer separate from the analyst.
